text.p: The following are the reports carried by Estonia's newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- 2,900 men from eight countries, among them 1,400 from the United States, will be taking part in Baltic Challenge exercise from July 14-22.
- The interior minister dismissed the prefect of the Tallinn police Aivar Toompere after a shooting incident in Saturday night in which a police officer caused serious injury to a woman,
- United States Secretary of State Madeleine Albright told the three Baltic foreign ministers that an invitation to NATO in 1999 cannot be guaranteed but all states eligible for membership can apply.
- The main award at the Parnu Visual Anthropology Festival went to DaneThomas Stendrup for "Portal of eternal peace".
- Businessmen see the Centre Party's intention to adopt a progressive income tax as a turn to the left, leaders of several large companies said.
